name: deps_write

ops.description: Write operations, one flat object per op, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

from.description: Source item of the edge (the blocker for blocks): a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: create, delete, fan_out]

to.description: Target item of the edge (the blocked item for blocks): a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: create, delete, fan_in]

type.description: Edge type: blocks or relates_to. Create applies blocks when absent; delete matches either type when absent.

unblockAt.description: Role the blocker must reach to unblock the target: queue, work, review or terminal (default terminal). Not allowed with relates_to. [ops: create, linear, fan_out, fan_in]

id.description: Full dependency UUID (not a prefix). [ops: delete]

item.description: Delete every edge touching this item (either end). Item id: a UUID or a hex prefix of 8 to 32 characters. [ops: delete]

ids.description: Items in chain order, at least 2: each one blocks the next. [ops: linear]

toIds.description: Target items, at least 1: from blocks each of them. [ops: fan_out]

fromIds.description: Source items, at least 1: each of them blocks to. [ops: fan_in]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars, needs actor). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Create and delete dependency edges between items: create, delete, and the patterns linear, fan_out and fan_in (one element, all edges or none). Each op needs the manage-dependencies capability and sees only items in scope. Result: an edge {id, from, to, type, unblockAt?}, {created: [edge]} or {deleted: n}. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
